rules.rule: A comment changes only when it fails the checklist
must: a comment changes only when it fails the checklist
A comment that passes is left alone

rules.rule: Props, events, slots, model are named in the header block; member TSDoc is moved there and deleted
must: does not name, in\s+backticks, every prop, event, slot, and model
Move any fact it holds that the header\s+block lacks into the block, then delete it

rules.rule: Never write a fact the code does not establish
must: Never write a fact you cannot confirm from the code; flag it instead
never on a category the code\s+leaves open

rules.rule: File, directory, and all targets present a plan and wait
must: Wait for approval, then run the loop and Verify

rules.rule: No target works the items the working diff touches; an empty diff asks
must: diff \(default, no target\) — every item whose code or comment the working\s+diff changes
An empty diff: say so and ask\s+for a target

rules.rule: Fan-out is automatic by size, announced in the plan; the parent re-reads workers' comments
must: Fan-out is automatic: a target spanning several directories with more than\s+~40 files or ~3000 lines
whether the run fans out and why

rules.rule: Unrecognized tokens are named and defaults run; an empty target resolution asks
must: Read the tokens in any order: a reserved word is a mode or flag, `key=value`\s+is a control, and anything else is the target
say it was not\s+recognized, name the ones that exist, and run with the defaults as if it were absent
A target\s+that resolves to nothing: say so and ask — never guess what to work on

rules.rule: max= is a hard cap on comments changed; what is left is reported
must: `max=N` — hard cap on comments changed; report what is left
